content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a few adjustments before signing:

- The relevant clause on ownership of deliverables currently gives the client full ownership before payment is received. This means I would lose control of my work without compensation. I propose that ownership of each deliverable transfer to the client only after full payment of all invoices related to that deliverable; until then, the deliverable remains the property of the contractor.
- The payment term listed as "Net ninety (90) days from the Effective Date" would delay payment well beyond the usual 30‑day window and could strain cash flow. I suggest changing the term to "Net thirty (30) days from the Effective Date."

Please let me know if these modifications are acceptable. Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards
